note: Every measurement below came from an artifact retrieved on 2026-09-21. Sources that could not be retrieved are marked retrieved:false and carry no field claims.

workingDefinition.statement: Transmission headroom is the signed MW by which flow across a specific monitored element or interface, in a specific direction, under a specific contingency assumption, differs from the limit the operator was enforcing at that moment.

feasibilityClasses.A: source exposes a defensible headroom metric directly
feasibilityClasses.B: source exposes compatible flow and limit allowing calculation
feasibilityClasses.C: only a capability or limit proxy is public
feasibilityClasses.D: public data cannot support a defensible headroom metric

traps.detail: 9999 and -9999 mean unmonitored in that direction, not a limit. headroom = 1273.04 - (-9999) would fabricate 11272 MW on CENTRAL EAST. Six interfaces carry -9999; WEST CENTRAL carries +9999.
In 2002-01 through 2005-01 every row carried unsigned 9999 in BOTH limit columns. Real limits begin exactly 2005-02-01; the signed -9999 sentinel appears from 2007-11.
CENTRAL EAST carried both 2690 and 2740 within one day; UPNY CONED 5680 and 5800; SCH - HQ - NY negative limit -100 and -985. No static rating table is valid.

Pre-2005-02 timestamps were irregular with seconds. From 2005-02 they are clean HH:MM, but the series is still NOT a fixed 5-minute grid: off-grid stamps and skipped slots occur daily (see cadenceEvidence).

11 interfaces in 2002 to 19 in 2026, and 8 Point IDs were renamed (some twice). Identity must be Point ID, never name. CENTRAL-EAST 23313 was replaced by a DIFFERENT id 23330, which a name matcher would wrongly merge.

SCH - HQ_CEDARS has limits 49/0 and flow 0.0 all day. Record as zero_flow_direction_undetermined; inactivity is a property of a run of observations, not one row, and the source publishes no in-service flag.
SCH - PJM_NEPTUNE sat at exactly 660.0 against a 660 limit for every interval. Headroom 0.0 is a correct observation and must not render as missing.

All 1218 zero-headroom rows on 2026-09-20 are HVDC or controllable merchant ties at exactly their rating. On a scheduled tie that is routine full scheduling; on a free-flowing AC interface the same arithmetic means congestion. No "interfaces at their limit" count may be published until subtype is resolved.

sentinelRule.whyNotThreshold: max genuine limit observed is 9899 on SCH - HQ_IMPORT_EXPORT (4074 observations), only 100 MW below the sentinel. A >=9000 threshold would discard real data.

subtypeRule.reason: Source publishes no structured subtype field. Name prefix "SCH - " is a heuristic and names are provably unstable. Point ID range fails: external ties 23316/23317/23318/23324 sit inside the internal series. No NYISO interface catalogue found (MIS directory listing 403).
subtypeRule.recommendation: Record Interface Name and Point ID raw; implement no subtype classifier. Logged unresolved, not guessed.

directionFormula.pseudocode: if flow>0: sentinel(pos)? unmonitored : pos-flow | if flow<0: sentinel(neg)? unmonitored : abs(neg)-abs(flow) | if flow==0: zero_flow_direction_undetermined

zeroAndDeadStates.finding: Every zero-headroom interface is an HVDC or controllable merchant tie at exactly its rating. On a scheduled controllable tie, flow == limit is routine full scheduling, not congestion. On a free-flowing AC interface the same arithmetic means congestion.
zeroAndDeadStates.consequence: No "interfaces at their limit" count may be published until the subtype question is resolved.
zeroAndDeadStates.deadTieNote: SCH - HQ_CEDARS (limits 49/0, flow 0.0 all 289 observations) looks inactive, but the source publishes no in-service flag and inactivity is a property of a run of observations, not one row. Record each row as zero_flow_direction_undetermined.

traps.detail: Only constraints SCED was actively managing appear. 30 constraints out of thousands of elements. An element with abundant headroom never appears, so the denominator is invisible and this cannot answer 'how much headroom does ERCOT have'.
ViolatedMW equals -(Limit - Value) to within 0.1 MW; 52 of 332 rows differ by rounding only.
NONCOMP on every observed row; vocabulary unresolved.
Base-case constraints such as NELRIO carry empty FromStation/ToStation and 0 kV.

reasons: ATC exceeds TTC in 27.7% of direction-intervals, so ATC = TTC - TRM - CBM - usage is not merely inexact but impossible.

ATC answers 'how much more could be scheduled', not 'how far is flow from the limit'.

crossMarket.reason: The quantities are different objects, not differently measured versions of one object. NYISO is a margin on 19 named interfaces against all-in operating limits; ERCOT is a distance-to-limit on whichever ~30 elements SCED was managing, per contingency; CAISO is capability net of counterflow with no flow term; SPP publishes limits with no flow; MISO publishes neither.
crossMarket.constrainedCountReason: ERCOT and SPP denominators are the binding subset; NYISO's is a fixed roster of 19. The denominators are incompatible.
crossMarket.whatTravels: The shape of the finding, not the magnitude. 'This interface is at its limit' is comparable; 'this market has N MW of headroom' is not.

hardInvariants: a margin may only be formed from a flow and a limit sharing market, source interface, entity, observation instant and direction
a sentinel limit never produces a margin: NYISO abs(limit)==9999 exactly; ERCOT limit failing the plausibility bound is limit_implausible
an unavailable or undetermined direction is null with a state, never 0
negative margin is preserved with its sign and never clamped
direction is selected before any absolute value is taken
ERCOT contingency_kind is retained and never collapsed
NYISO identity is Point ID; Interface Name never participates in matching
ERCOT identity is (ConstraintName, ContingencyName); ConstraintID is raw metadata only
raw source values are never overwritten by derived values
no cross-market aggregation of any kind
ATC never enters an operational headroom series
limit_field_used is recorded on every derived margin
binding state comes from the source (ShadowPrice), never derived from the margin
no count of "interfaces at their limit" until the NYISO subtype question is resolved

recommendedTh2.rationale: NYISO is the only source publishing flow and a directional limit together as a standing series, with no auth, a stable schema since 2010, a numeric Point ID and roughly two decades of monthly archives. ERCOT publishes genuine limit/flow pairs with explicit contingency naming and a clean source-backed binding indicator, and the IQ-3 ERCOT reader already solves its listing idiom.
scope: canonical foundation with transmission_interface and transmission_element separate
limit and flow observations joined into a margin only where both exist at the same grain
sentinel handling enforced in the database
NYISO ingestion, current plus monthly archive backfill, with the 2005-era convention detected and handled as a separate schema
ERCOT NP6-86-CD ingestion, forward-only, labelled explicitly as the binding subset
no frontend, no public API, no cross-market metric
recommendedTh2.precondition: Rights review for the NYISO MIS interface and the ERCOT MIS interface must be completed and recorded before TH-2 ingestion, not alongside it.

derivedVsRawPublication.nyiso: ambiguous for every purpose; accepted risk applies uniformly
derivedVsRawPublication.ercot: MORE permissive for derived analytics than for verbatim republication: raw data in compilations, charts and analyses is exempt from the notice requirement, while verbatim content must be unmodified with notices retained.

productCopy.nyiso: Remaining operating margin on the nineteen transmission interfaces NYISO publishes, in the direction power is actually flowing. It covers those published interfaces only, not every line in New York, and a direction NYISO does not monitor is reported as unavailable rather than as zero.
productCopy.ercot: Remaining margin on the transmission constraints ERCOT's real-time dispatch was actively tracking, under the specific contingency each one protects against. ERCOT publishes these only while a constraint is being managed, so this describes where the grid was tight, not how much room the network has overall.

th1aUnresolved: NYISO subtype: no structured discriminator exists; blocks any "interfaces at their limit" count and nothing else
NYISO -9899 on SCH - HQ_IMPORT_EXPORT: treated as real under the exact-9999 rule, but 4074 identical values on one interface may be another disabled-limit convention
NYISO era-4 onset: positive 9999 reappears by 2020, exact month unbisected; harmless under the exact rule
NYISO timezone: timestamps carry no offset; DST and the repeated autumn hour are unverified
ERCOT implausible-limit bound: no exact sentinel exists, so the threshold is a judgement that must be stated in the methodology
ERCOT RepeatedHourFlag: N on all 1216 rows; the DST-repeat case is unobserved
ERCOT terms volatility: ERCOT may change terms without notice; re-verify periodically
neither source publishes a rating type (normal/emergency/ambient-adjusted); limit_field_used records the column, not the rating class
